Why ClinAssure

Safety isn't a sign-off. It's a starting point.

Too many health technology projects treat clinical safety as a hurdle at the end — a document to produce, a box to tick before go-live. By then, the risky decisions have already been made.

We work the other way round. ClinAssure embeds clinical assurance into your programme from the first design conversation, so safety, compliance, and clinical usability shape the product rather than delay it.

The result: faster approvals, fewer late-stage surprises, and technology that clinicians actually trust.

Services

Clinical assurance, end to end.

Clinical risk management

Hazard identification, risk assessment, and clinical risk management aligned to DCB0129 and DCB0160 — built into your delivery cadence, not bolted on.

Safety cases & documentation

Clear, defensible safety cases and hazard logs that stand up to scrutiny from trusts, regulators, and clinical safety officers.

Regulatory readiness

Guidance through the standards landscape — from medical device classification to information governance — so approvals don't stall your roadmap.

Transformation assurance

Independent clinical oversight of digital transformation programmes, keeping patient safety visible at every decision point.

Training & capability

Practical training for product, engineering, and programme teams, building the clinical safety capability that stays after we leave.

Approach

How an engagement works.

STEP 01

Understand

We map your product, your clinical context, and your regulatory obligations — quickly, and in plain language.

STEP 02

Embed

Clinical assurance activities are woven into your existing delivery process, with clear ownership and no duplicated work.

STEP 03

Assure

You go live with evidence, not assumptions — a complete assurance trail and a team that knows how to keep it current.
